commands.review_summary:
The PR adds stdout/stderr error handling around qa-lab gateway child process spawns and adds focused regression tests for stream error handling.

PR surface: Source +73, Tests +76. Total +149 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible: current main has three pipe-backed child spawn paths with data listeners but no stdout/stderr error listeners, and Node throws an unhandled error event without a listener. I did not run a full live qa-lab gateway crash reproduction.

target.title: fix(qa-lab): handle stdout/stderr stream errors in gateway child spawns
target.body:
## Summary

- add stdout/stderr `error` handlers to the three qa-lab gateway child spawn sites
- the new handlers reject the surrounding CLI command promise with a clear
  `qa gateway cli {stream} stream failed: ...` message and SIGKILL the orphaned
  child so a destroy(err) on the parent-side Readable cannot leak an unhandled
  error event
- for the long-lived gateway start / replacement spawns, the new handlers write
  a diagnostic line into the QA gateway log buffer and SIGTERM the child, so
  the existing `monitorQaGatewayChildSpawnError` lifecycle observes the
  failure through the normal `close` event instead of via an unhandled error
- cover the runQaGatewayCliCommand stream error path with a real-process
  regression test that emits a synthetic `error` on the mocked stdout and
  stderr streams and asserts both the rejection and the SIGKILL

## Why this change is needed

`runQaGatewayCliCommand`, the L965 gateway start, and the L1087 replacement
gateway all spawn the OpenClaw CLI with `stdio: ["ignore", "pipe", "pipe"]` and
register a `data` handler on stdout/stderr, but neither stream has an `error`
handler. Node's EventEmitter contract is that an `error` event on a stream
without a registered listener becomes an `uncaughtException`. On a real
test-machine teardown — the parent process exiting, the kernel resetting the
pipe, the child being SIGKILLed mid-write — that contract fires and crashes
the test runner.

## Verification

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — passed; 1 file, 73 tests passed (71 pre-existing + 2 new stream-error tests)
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — all files correctly formatted
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.extensions.json extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.ts extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — no findings
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions` — passed
- `pnpm tsgo:extensions:test` — passed (test files typecheck clean, no `err.errorBody = ...` style direct assignment issues)
- mutation check: removing the new `child.stdout.on("error", ...)` block makes the new `rejects with a clear error when stdout pipe fails mid-run` test fail with `expected "kill" to be called 1 times, but got 0 times`; restoring the block makes the same test pass

## Evidence

The full preflight output (lint, format, typecheck, test) for this PR is captured
in the per-step sections below. The decisive evidence is in
[## Real behavior proof](#real-behavior-proof) — the before/after probe of the
production `runQaGatewayCliCommand` helper with a real child process
(510 ms / 580 ms wall-clock, 73/73 tests pass).

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: qa-lab gateway child stdout/stderr stream errors no longer leak as unhandled `error` events. `runQaGatewayCliCommand` rejects with `qa gateway cli stdout stream failed: ...` / `qa gateway cli stderr stream failed: ...` and SIGKILLs the orphaned child. The QA gateway start / replacement spawns log `gateway child {stream} stream failed: ...` into the gateway output buffer and SIGTERM the gateway so the existing child lifecycle observes the failure.

**Real environment tested**: local Linux Node 22.22 source checkout. The new regression tests use a real child process spawned via `process.execPath --eval ...` and assert the rejection behavior end-to-end; the `attachOutputProcessHandlers` test is unit-level and uses EventEmitter mocks because the production helper runs in-process.

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts` — full file passes
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts -t "pipe fails mid-run" --reporter=verbose` — confirms the 2 new tests by name:
  - `rejects with a clear error when stdout pipe fails mid-run` (~510 ms)
  - `rejects with a clear error when stderr pipe fails mid-run` (~580 ms)

**Evidence after fix** (output of the verbose test run, abbreviated):
```
✓ |extension-qa| extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts > runQaGatewayCliCommand > rejects with a clear error when stdout pipe fails mid-run 510ms
✓ |extension-qa| extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.test.ts > runQaGatewayCliCommand > rejects with a clear error when stderr pipe fails mid-run 580ms

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  73 passed (73)
```

The stdout-pipe test asserts:
- `await expect(promise).rejects.toThrow(/qa gateway cli stdout stream failed: synthetic parent stdout read failure/)`
- `expect(proc.kill).toHaveBeenCalledWith("SIGKILL")` (the spawned child is SIGKILLed by the fix to avoid the child outliving the failed Readable)

**Observed result after fix**: the previously unhandled `child.stdout.on("error", ...)` and `child.stderr.on("error", ...)` paths are now caught inside the existing `runQaGatewayCliCommand` promise contract. The long-lived `attemptChild` / `nextChild` spawns in `startQaGatewayChild` surface stream errors through the same gateway log buffer used by `child.on("error")`, which `monitorQaGatewayChildSpawnError` already reads.

**What was not tested**: a real OS-level EPIPE or RST triggered by a parent process being SIGKILLed externally. Local Linux Node child processes do not always surface that condition as a stream `error` event in the test environment, so the regression test exercises the simpler `error` event contract directly. The pattern is identical to what Alix-007 used in #101597 (matrix deps MERGED 2026-07-08) and cxbAsDev used in #101394 (voice-call tunnel MERGED 2026-07-07) — those PRs also rely on a synthetic `error` event for their regression tests, not a kernel-level RST.

## Campaign coordination

This PR is part of the active stream-error campaign wave in 2026-07:

- MERGED: #101394 voice-call tunnel (cxbAsDev), #101402 memory-host-sdk, #101597 matrix deps (Alix-007), #101596 google-meet realtime (Alix-007)
- OPEN: #101598 microsoft-foundry az login (Alix-007), #101599 codex-supervisor stdio (Alix-007), #101846 acpx mcp-proxy (qingminglong), #102047 acp createAcpClient (sunlit-deng), #101506 browser chrome stderr (mikasa0818)

**Collision check**: no open PR found for `extensions/qa-lab/src/gateway-child.ts` or for the QA gateway stream-error issue. Verified via `gh pr list --state all --search "qa-lab" --json number,title,state` and file-level `gh pr list --state all --search "gateway-child" --json number,title,state`; the only fuzzy hits are unrelated test-infra PRs.
